title: Trophy and keepsake items (lean wolf's pelt, gaunt rib-bone, peat-stained bronze torc, old captain's seal-ring, saint's small reliquary, etc.) stay in inventory forever after their one use, with no drop/discard action, so the pack only grows — 23 items carried by game's end.

Trophy and keepsake items (lean wolf's pelt, gaunt rib-bone, peat-stained bronze torc, old captain's seal-ring, saint's small reliquary, etc.) stay in inventory forever after their one use, with no drop/discard action, so the pack only grows — 23 items carried by game's end.
